prerequisites: Knowledge of mass and energy balances

learning_outcomes.text: Identify environmental aspects of different industrial activities, selecting the most significant ones.
Identify legal requirements regarding pollution prevention and control.
Manage preventive and corrective environmental management tools: environmental impact assessment, environmental management systems, environmental audits.
Propose methodologies for the treatment, valorization, and disposal of effluents and waste.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to environment and sustainable development
General aspects and measurement of atmospheric pollution
Dispersion of pollutants in the atmosphere
Treatment and control of atmospheric pollution
General aspects of water pollution. Impacts and regulations
Physical treatments for water pollution reduction
Biological treatments for water pollution reduction
Advanced treatments for water pollution reduction
Management, treatment and disposal of municipal waste
Industrial waste. Management, treatment and disposal of hazardous waste
assessment_rules: For ordinary call, if all minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as [0.65 x (0.5 x (P1+P2)] + (0.12 x PA) +(0.08 x TG) + (0.15 x PL) if P1 is passed, or 0.65 x (E) + (0.12 x PA) +(0.08 x TG) + (0.15 x PL) if P1 is not presented or failed. A minimum grade of 1.5/5 is required in each part (theory/problems) of the exams and 4/10 for P1, P2, E, PA, TG, PL. For extraordinary call, the final grade is 0.65 x (E) + (0.12 x PA) +(0.08 x TG) + (0.15 x PL), with similar minimums for E and an additional practical exam for PL if the minimum is not met. For differentiated evaluation, the final grade is 0.7 x (E) + (0.15 x T) + (0.15 x PL), with similar minimums for E and PL.
